import sys, os, time, hashlib, io
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
from types import ModuleType
from collections import Counter
from itertools import product
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from dealroom_sign import placement as _p
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement import TWO
rc = R24.rc
live = open('/root/worktrees/send-merge/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py').read()
assert hashlib.sha256(live.encode()).hexdigest().startswith('866637df')
assert hashlib.sha256(open(_p.__file__,'rb').read()).hexdigest().startswith('e55bf345')
SRC = dict(r28=live, r29=open(_p.__file__).read())
def mk(n):
    m = ModuleType('rev28q4b_'+n); m.__file__ = _p.__file__; sys.modules[m.__name__] = m
    exec(compile(SRC[n], m.__name__, 'exec'), m.__dict__); return m
M = dict((n, mk(n)) for n in SRC)
http = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http')); calls = Counter()
def run(pages, people, allowed):
    b = rc.pages_pdf(pages); out = ''
    for n, m in M.items():
        mo = Mock(); r = in_process(m, b, people, mo); calls[n] += mo.call_count
        out += 'W' if rc.wrong_fields(r, allowed) else ('p' if r['fields'] else 'n')
    return out
X = 72; R = 340
FLEET = [(240, 'FLEET TEST CO.', False, X), (270, 'By:', True, X, 290), (300, 'Date:', True, X, 290)]
AFF = [(520, 'HARBOR LIGHT GROUP, INC.', False, X), (560, 'By:', True, X, 290), (600, 'Date:', True, X, 290)]
NAMES = [['Pat Smith, CEO'], ['Pat Smith'], ['Pat Smith / CEO'], ['PAT SMITH'], ['Pat Smith', 'Chief Executive Officer'], ['Pat Smith', 'Title: CEO']]
HEADS = ['For and on behalf of the Recipient', 'harbor light analytics, inc.', 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.', None]
def shapes():
    for nm, head in product(NAMES, HEADS):
        # hidden Pat stack in the right column, beside Fleet's block (same rows), affiliate below-left
        hd = [(210, head, False, R)] if head else []
        side = hd + [(270, '', True, R, 560)] + [(282 + 12 * i, t, False, R) for i, t in enumerate(nm)]
        yield 'two_col_beside_fleet', nm, head, [FLEET + side + AFF], (2, R - 20, 270, 560)
        # hidden Pat stack in the right column, beside the affiliate's block
        side = ([(490, head, False, R)] if head else []) + [(560, '', True, R, 560)] + [(572 + 12 * i, t, False, R) for i, t in enumerate(nm)]
        yield 'two_col_beside_aff', nm, head, [FLEET + AFF + side], (2, R - 20, 560, 560)
G = Counter(); EX = Counter(); t = time.time()
with patch('httpx.Client.send', http):
    for shape, nm, head, sigpages, pat_allowed in shapes():
        for recital, signer in product(('parsed', 'none'), ('domain', 'explicit', 'both')):
            pat = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)
            if signer == 'explicit': pat['company'] = 'Harbor Light Analytics, Inc.'
            people = [TWO[1], pat] if signer == 'both' else [pat]
            k = run([list(rc.RECITALS[recital])] + sigpages, people, dict([(rc.PE, pat_allowed), (rc.DE, (2, 0, 270, 300))]))
            G[(shape, recital, k)] += 1
            if 'W' in k or k[0] != k[1]: EX[(shape, k, recital, signer, ' | '.join(nm), head)] += 1
    # conformed /s/ detail
    hd = [(340, 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.', False, X)]
    pages = [list(rc.RECITALS['parsed']), FLEET + hd + [(370, '/s/ Pat Smith', False, X), (382, 'Pat Smith, CEO', False, X)] + AFF]
    r = _p.place(rc.pages_pdf(pages), [dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)], model_client=Mock())
    print('conformed worker r28:', r['status'], [(f['type'], f['page'], f['evidence']['line'], f['confidence']) for f in r['fields']], [(a.get('score'), a.get('margin')) for a in r['assignments']])
print('http', http.call_count, 'model', dict(calls), 'elapsed', round(time.time() - t), 'cells', sum(G.values()))
for x in sorted(G.items(), key=str): print(x)
for x in sorted(EX.items(), key=str): print(' ', x)
